from pathlib import Path
import os,json
paths=[]
for key in ('APPDATA','LOCALAPPDATA','PROGRAMDATA'):
 root=os.environ.get(key,'')
 if not root:continue
 base=Path(root)
 for sub in ('Proxifier','Initex','TgWsProxy','TGWSProxy'):
  p=base/sub
  if p.is_dir():
   files=[]
   try:
    files=[{'name':x.name,'suffix':x.suffix,'size_bytes':x.stat().st_size} for x in p.iterdir() if x.is_file()][:35]
   except OSError:pass
   paths.append({'root':key,'sub':sub,'files':files})
print(json.dumps({'paths':paths},ensure_ascii=True))
